title: ECU — Evidence Cluster Unit
description: One scored row: (ingredient, form, dose_band, outcome, population). Not a subagent contract — no model ever emits this. It is the output of the deterministic scorer and the shape of the storage row. See SPEC sections 1 and 9.

ecu_key.description: Stable join key. ingredient|form|dose_band|outcome|population_id, with 'unbanded' where dose_band is null. Recomputed, never authored.

form_vocab_id.description: id from vocab/form.json for this ingredient.

dose_band.description: null until bands are DERIVED from observed trial doses. null is a valid, expected state in v1 — not a missing value.

band_version.description: 0 = unbanded (bands not yet derived). Increments whenever bands are re-derived; a change invalidates every cached ECU carrying an older version. SPEC section 5 complexity flag.

dose_range_mg.description: Observed dose range backing this row. Populated even when band_version is 0 — this is the raw material bands get derived from.

score.description: null when the sufficiency gate fired. 0 means inconclusive and nothing else.

components.description: Every term of 100*d*c*(1-0.4H), stored so any published number can be reconstructed.

study_ids.description: Canonical ids of the UNIQUE primaries. This is what makes a score auditable.

transferred_from.description: Studies reaching this ECU only via transfer, with the discount each carried. Most ECUs are populated this way — SPEC section 8.

flags.description: Shown to the user, NEVER scored. Unpublished trials, brand funding, predatory venue, underdosed product.

computed_at.description: ISO-8601. Text, so the row is portable to Postgres/Supabase unchanged.

provenance.description: The same bottle must produce the same score tomorrow. If it does not, this block says which input moved.
